title: Digital Charisma
coreMove: Replace missing physical cues with deliberate timing, specificity, and human signal in digital channels.
sourcePressure: The source frames online charisma as a current applied topic where presence, power, warmth, and internal-state carryover must adapt to reduced-channel interaction.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version becomes remote-work etiquette or personal branding. The useful version shows how to send presence, credibility, and goodwill when the channel strips away body language.

exampleSpecs.domain: a telehealth portal message from a dermatologist to a worried patient
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinician whose brevity can feel like dismissal online
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the patient follows the patch-test plan instead of spiraling through search results
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the dermatologist opens with the exact concern from the uploaded photo before giving the instruction, showing she has actually looked
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a magnified rash photo beside a blinking portal reply box

exampleSpecs.domain: an asynchronous design review for a museum kiosk interface
exampleSpecs.audience: a remote lead whose comments need authority without chill
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a contractor fixes the navigation problem without feeling ambushed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she chooses a screen-recorded walkthrough with two timestamped notes instead of a blunt paragraph of corrections
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a paused screen recording on a touchscreen floorplan

exampleSpecs.domain: a grant-review email to a rural arts collective after a partial rejection
exampleSpecs.audience: an administrator whose message must carry respect through bad news
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the collective reapplies instead of feeling brushed aside
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: contrast the template rejection with the revised email that names the strongest project detail before explaining the missing budget evidence
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a draft rejection email split beside a scanned mural budget

exampleSpecs.domain: a remote robotics team troubleshooting thread during a regional qualifier
exampleSpecs.audience: a teen captain leading through chat under time pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether scattered teammates stop duplicating fixes before the match
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she pins one clear diagnostic step, tags the battery lead by role, and thanks the person who already ruled out the loose cable
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a phone screen smeared with pit grease above a match countdown

exampleSpecs.domain: a voice note from a travel nurse to a supervisor she has never met
exampleSpecs.audience: a mobile worker who needs warmth without a long message
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the supervisor trusts her judgment about an unsafe housing assignment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she records a thirty-second note that starts with the shared goal, gives one concrete safety detail, and leaves space for a decision
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a voice-note waveform over a photo of a broken exterior lock

exampleSpecs.domain: a condolence text from a project manager to a supplier after a family death
exampleSpecs.audience: a professional who wants to be human without overstepping
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the supplier feels respected while logistics still move
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he deletes the efficient first draft, names the person's father once, and separates the shipment question into a later message
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an unsent text cursor blinking after a supplier's father's name

skillTargets: replace missing physical cues with specific evidence of attention
choose digital timing that signals presence without urgency theater
evaluate whether a digital message carries credibility and goodwill

tryThisNowSpec: Before sending one digital message, add one specific sign that you saw their actual situation, then remove one sentence that only proves you are busy.
